title: Lipidomics Data Analysis
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Average the replicates of the MOCK control:

steps.title: Prepare Raw Data
steps.instruction: Open the raw lipidomics data in Microsoft Excel and handle missing values.

substeps.instruction: Replace all missing values in the raw data with 0 to prevent calculation errors.

steps.title: Calculate Lipid Metrics
steps.instruction: Perform initial calculations for total lipid amounts and molar percentages.

steps.title: Categorize Lipids
steps.instruction: Group lipid species into the following categories:

substeps.instruction: Cholesterol PC: Includes PC and LPC
OTHERS: Includes CE, Cer, DAG, GlcCer, LacCer, PG, and TAG

steps.title: Average Biological Replicates
steps.instruction: For each lipid species, calculate the mean value across the three biological replicates.

steps.title: Perform Background Correction
steps.instruction: Subtract the averaged MOCK control values from each replicate of the ATG9A vesicle samples for each lipid species.

substeps.instruction: Set any resulting negative values to 0.

steps.title: Calculate Final Molar Percentages
steps.instruction: Determine the final %mol values using the background-corrected data.

substeps.instruction: Apply the formula: %mol = (individual lipid species / total lipids of that condition) × 100
Calculate the mean molar percentage across all replicates for each group of lipids to obtain the final lipid composition.
